correctness.rationale: Complete case proof for n=1, a prime power, odd p^a q^b, and 2^a q^b; uses exact bi-unitary prime-power factorization, 2-adic valuations, coprime constraints, and a proved local power-of-two lemma. The odd-support branch forces 45, even branch forces 6. Both checked directly. Separate exact-arithmetic sweep checks 367,461 n<=10^6 with <=2 supports and 1,188 local exponent cases; the exhaustive-for-all-n theorem follows from the proof, not finite checks.

value.rationale: Exact complete classification of an intrinsic naturally defined quotient first proposed with other harmonic variants by Sándor, for the entire unrestricted first two prime-support strata. Uniformly excludes arbitrary large exponents and closes more than isolated small exponent cases. Its denominator sigma** differs from H*, so the equality of small witness sets does not render the result a corollary; example n=270 shows the predicates are genuinely distinct.
